continuity.arc_goal: Implement three parallel workstreams: (1) linked services Phase A — object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade; (2) issue #4566 fix — awakeable signal loss during leadership transitions; (3) DST Phase 0-1 — seed-based simulation testing of StateMachine::apply for long-term testing infrastructure

progress_update.summary: Researched issue #4566 (awakeable signal loss during leadership transitions), designed fix strategy, analyzed performance impact, designed test strategy, then pivoted to researching Deterministic Simulation Testing (DST) for Restate. Created comprehensive DST research document, wrote implementation plan for DST Phase 0-1 (state machine simulation), and got it reviewed. Reviewer recommended significant simplification: drop the SimState oracle, use storage-level invariants, start with 3-4 command types. Ready to update plan and create tasks.
progress_update.goal: Three parallel tracks: (1) linked services Phase A implementation, (2) issue #4566 fix (awakeable signal loss), (3) DST Phase 0-1 — seed-based simulation test for StateMachine::apply

progress_update.now: Plan review complete for DST Phase 0-1. Need to update plan with reviewer's simplifications, then create task breakdown. User was asked whether to update plan or go straight to tasks.
next_steps: Update DST Phase 0-1 plan with reviewer's simplifications (drop SimState, single file, storage invariants, 3-4 command types)
Create task breakdown for simplified DST Phase 0-1
Implement DST Phase 0-1: extend TestEnv with apply_with, write simulation.rs with seeded command generation + invariant checking
Resume linked-services Phase A implementation (Wave 1: ServiceEdges table, NodeId, VirtualObjectStatus::Completed)
constraints: All tables are logical (2-byte KeyKind prefix) within one RocksDB CF per partition — no write amplification from multiple tables
NodeId enum with Object variant only for Phase A — WorkflowInvocation added in Phase B
Proto type IDs: LinkService=0x0415/0x8015, CompleteService=0x0416/0x8016, UnlinkService=0x0417
StateMachine::apply is already near-pure — no internal randomness or system time
TestEnv uses real RocksDB (no in-memory storage impl) — sufficient for Phase 1
Mock helpers (InvocationId::mock_random) use unseeded rand::rng() — must bypass for determinism
TestEnv::apply hardcodes is_leader=true, MillisSinceEpoch::now(), Lsn::OLDEST — must parameterize
NotifySignalRequest and InvocationResponse need Optional request_id field added for #4566 fix
WAL serialization must remain backward compatible (Option<T> defaults to None)
ServiceCompletionNotification and InvocationResponse are orthogonal — graph management vs result delivery
Completed objects reject new invocations at inbox AND state mutations from in-flight handlers
Direct cycle detection only (point read) — transitive cycles cause GC leak but not correctness issue
decisions: Three parallel tracks for the project: linked-services Phase A, #4566 fix, and DST Phase 0-1 seeded simulation testing
Custom seed-based generation over proptest — proptest shrinking doesn't work well for stateful sequences with RocksDB
Plan reviewer recommends: HashSet<InvocationId> instead of SimState oracle, storage-level invariants (no oracle), single simulation.rs file, 3-4 command types with uniform distribution
Strategy A for #4566 fix: migrate append_signal/append_invocation_response to handle_rpc_proposal_command with new Action::ForwardAppendedResponse
Single Action::ForwardAppendedResponse rather than per-command action variants — all 3 high-priority sites return Appended
Level 1 RPC handler test as primary failing test — follows existing append_invocation.rs test patterns with MockActuator
Defer restart_as_new_invocation legacy path fix — it's being deprecated as fleet upgrades past protocol V4
Unlink (not RemoveLink) as the verb for edge removal — UnlinkServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceRequest, ctx.unlink()
VirtualObjectStatus: Unlocked | Locked(InvocationId) | Completed(ResponseResult) — mutually exclusive, Completed is terminal
Vertical command slices for linked-services implementation — each command task covers its full stack (journal + proto + codec + outbox + WAL)
EdgeState on LinkedTo: Active { completion_handler_name } | Completed — handler name consumed on completion, drops out
GC cascade: no parents + Completed → delete state/promises/status/edges + propagate UnlinkServiceRequest to children
Phase A ships independently from Phase B (invocation linking) — Phase A anchors only objects, Phase B adds WorkflowInvocation nodes
